name: convert
description: Converts files between formats with free command-line tools and checks the result: video, audio, images, PDF, office documents, e-books, archives, subtitles, text encodings and data.

interface.longDescription: Ask in plain words and the assistant converts the file with a free command-line tool, then checks the result before saying it is done: video and audio (play on a phone or TV, compress to a size, cut, join, GIF, extract sound), photos (HEIC to JPEG, WebP, AVIF), PDF (merge, split, compress, OCR to searchable), DjVu, Word, Excel and PowerPoint to PDF, Markdown, e-books, archives, subtitles, garbled text encodings, JSON, YAML, CSV. The original file is never changed. Nothing is installed without the person's yes and nothing is sent over the network.
defaultPrompt: Convert this HEIC photo to JPEG.
Make this video play on my phone.
